subject.title: fix(browser): use public ssrf runtime import in CDP proxy bypass

question: Should `registerManagedProxyBrowserCdpBypass` stay on the private owner-scoped `ssrf-runtime-internal` path, or be promoted into the public `ssrf-runtime` Plugin SDK contract?
rationale: The current PR cannot compile without either restoring private packaged resolution or expanding the public SDK surface for a proxy-bypass helper, and that boundary is security-sensitive.

options.title: Preserve Private Owner-Scoped Access
options.body: Fix packaged Browser/Ollama resolution through the existing private owner-scoped path or staging alias, keeping the bypass helper out of public SDK exports.

options.title: Approve Public SSRF Runtime Export
options.body: Promote the helper to `ssrf-runtime` only with explicit SDK/security approval, docs, guardrail updates, and package smoke proof.

options.title: Pick A Canonical Sibling
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers choose a sibling PR such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96994 as the canonical repair path.

recommendation.title: Preserve Private Owner-Scoped Access
recommendation.body: Fix packaged Browser/Ollama resolution through the existing private owner-scoped path or staging alias, keeping the bypass helper out of public SDK exports.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the current private SSRF runtime owner-gating pattern most directly affected by the decision.
